Liquid Glass Design Themes for 'shiny' Applications

Source: R/shinyglass-package.R
shinyglass-package.Rd

Drop-in Liquid Glass themes for shiny. This is the installed usage page. help("shinyglass") and help("shinyglass-package") open it (?shinyglass is the same page). vignette("shinyglass") is this recipe, and browseVignettes("shinyglass") lists that vignette.

Details

Pass glass_theme() to theme on a bslib page or fluidPage(), or start from glass_page(). Intensity runs from 0 (Ultra Clear) to 1 (Tinted). The default is 0.5.

Minimal app

glass_page() includes Light / Dark / Auto, the intensity slider, and accent wells, and it turns persistence on. Call observe_glass() in the server. Keep plot backgrounds transparent and take ink from glass_plot_colors().

library(shiny)
library(shinyglass)

ui <- glass_page(
  title = "Hello, glass",
  sliderInput("n", "Bars", 5, 30, 15),
  plotOutput("plot")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observe_glass(input, session)
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    pal <- glass_plot_colors(input = input)
    barplot(seq_len(input$n), col = pal$fill, border = NA, col.axis = pal$ink)
  }, bg = "transparent")
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Existing app

Keep the page function you already use. Pass the theme, add the controls, and observe them. page_sidebar(), page_fluid(), page_navbar(), page_fillable(), and navbarPage() all take theme. fluidPage(theme = glass_theme()) works too.

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(shinyglass)

ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "Existing app",
  theme = glass_theme(preset = "auto", intensity = 0.5),
  sidebar = sidebar(
    glass_theme_toggle(),
    glass_intensity_slider()
  ),
  "Main column"
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observe_glass(input, session)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

fluidPage() and navbarPage() take the same theme:

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = glass_theme(preset = "auto", intensity = 0.5),
  glass_theme_toggle(),
  glass_intensity_slider(),
  plotOutput("plot")
)

The server is unchanged: observe_glass(input, session).

glass_theme() does not remember choices (persist = FALSE). glass_page() does (persist = TRUE).

Key options

ArgumentDefaultAllowed
preset"light" on glass_theme(), "auto" on glass_page()"light", "dark", "auto"
intensity0.5number from 0 (Ultra Clear) to 1 (Tinted)
primary"#007AFF"hex, rgb(), or a name from glass_system_colors()
material"regular""regular". "clear" is deprecated
plot_surface"clear""clear", "opaque"
scene"default" ("tahoe" on glass_page())names(glass_scenes())
persistFALSE (TRUE on glass_page())TRUE or FALSE
refraction, morph, press, scroll_edge, minimize_tabsTRUETRUE or FALSE
icon_style"clear""clear", "color", "all"
floating_sidebarFALSETRUE or FALSE
specularTRUETRUE or FALSE. Highlights are static bands

update_glass_theme() changes these in a running app. NULL leaves that setting alone. When the user picks Auto, input$glass_preset stays "auto". Plot ink must use glass_resolved_preset(), which is "light" or "dark".

Migrating to 0.5.0

vignette("migrating") is the full note.

  • Default intensity moved from 0.45 to 0.5.

  • material = "clear" is deprecated. Delete it and pass intensity. When intensity is omitted, clear maps to 0.12 and warns. To keep that look, write intensity = 0.12.

  • Specular highlights no longer follow the pointer. specular = FALSE hides them.

  • refraction, morph, press, scroll_edge, minimize_tabs, and icon_style = "clear" are on by default. floating_sidebar stays off.

  • Page functions and click targets stay the same.

Pitfalls

  • App CSS that sets panel or text colors fights the theme. Use --glass-* tokens from glass_css_tokens(), or glass_theme(tokens = list(blur = "28px")).

  • Plots and tables are transparent. Pass bg = "transparent" to renderPlot(), or set plot_surface = "opaque" when the wallpaper makes the graphic hard to read. Color ink with glass_plot_colors().

  • observe_glass() only watches glass_toggle, glass_intensity, and glass_accent. A custom id needs the matching observe_glass_*() helper.

  • For shinyreact, name the theme: glass_page_react(theme = glass_theme()). An unnamed theme drops the CSS. page_react_html() has no theme argument; pass extra_deps = glass_theme_dependencies().

  • shinychat: page_chat(theme = glass_theme()). bslib offcanvas() uses the same material.

  • Reduced transparency, increased contrast, and forced colors override the glass. glass_flatten() or ?glass_flatten=1 removes blur for screenshots and PDF.

vignette("shinyglass") is this same recipe, installed with the package.
